note: The task edits conventions/gtd.md section 1 states, which every task consumer runs alike. Each case reads `input` (relative to this directory) as bytes, runs `edit` at the instant `now`, and compares with `expect`: `bytes`, a fixture the output equals byte for byte; `unchanged`, the output being the input's bytes and nothing written; `refused`, the edit refused and nothing written; `vtodo` with `names`, for a capture, the unfolded lines the new VTODO holds and the properties it states with any value; `value`, for a reading, the value read verbatim. Informative like the guide, authored from its prose.

cases.label: setting the state replaces the reserved value where it stood and restates both stamps
a task already in the target state is left untouched, its casing kept
a next action drops the reserved value and the line it leaves empty, another line kept
a next action is untouched when no reserved value is carried
with no reserved value to replace, the state is a line after the last CATEGORIES line
with no CATEGORIES at all, the state follows the last property, ahead of the alarm
foreign bytes are kept: the folded line, the X- properties, the parameters and the other CATEGORIES line, the escaped comma written back escaped
a plain category edit keeps the state and replaces the person's values where the first stood
a plain category edit across lines leaves the state's line byte for byte
a plain category edit with no person's value yet writes a line of its own
the person's values already the new ones leave the task untouched
a reserved value among the person's categories is refused
the contact replaces every CONTACT where the first stood, ALTREP given the address
an address alone is the contact's text, the line following the last property
the same contact already leaves the task untouched
a capture states CREATED and DTSTAMP at the instant, in the inbox
captured at reads DTSTAMP when there is no CREATED
